Tokentrim Pro Lifetime Price

Tokentrim Pro gives you a hosted dashboard, Monday digests, weekly budget alerts, Slack totals, and support for up to three machines for a one‑time fee of $49. The free toolkit already trims output, reads file ranges, and spools long responses to disk.

How it works for a single developer on macOS

  1. Install the free plugin with pip install tokentrim or clone the repo using git clone.
  2. Enable the Pro add‑on by visiting the Pro pricing page and paying $49.
  3. Open the hosted dashboard on any device; it shows your token usage, daily budget guard, and cold‑cache alerts.
  4. When you hit the 80 % weekly budget threshold, you receive a Slack alert.
  5. Run the replay command to see your own savings numbers.

What you get

  • Cost: $49 lifetime for the first 500 buyers.
  • Monthly: $9/month for ongoing use.
  • Machines: up to 3 devices.
  • Dashboard: hosted on a remote server, accessible from any device.
  • Alerts: weekly budget alert at 80 %, daily budget guard.
  • Slack: totals sent to your channel.
  • Data privacy: nothing leaves your machine by default.

FAQ

What does Pro add compared to the free version? Pro adds a hosted dashboard, Monday digests, weekly budget alerts, Slack totals, and support for up to three machines. The free version keeps all hooks, replay, and the dashboard locally.

Is a separate server required for the dashboard? No. The hosted dashboard runs on a remote server and is accessible from any device.

What happens when I reach my budget limit? The dashboard alerts you at 80 % of your weekly limit; you can adjust your settings or pause usage.

Next step

Visit the Tokentrim Pro pricing page to enable Pro and start saving.
